methodology.description: Manually curated, dated equity shareholding disclosures; not a real-time price or beneficial ownership dataset.
methodology.group_basis: A + B + C2, percentages rounded to two decimal places. Exclude C1 depository receipts from this denominator where the source does.
methodology.source_policy: Original issuer or NSE filing source. Link to the issuer filing or the exchange's filing index; if an index updates, historical figures remain explicitly dated.
methodology.limitations: Named shareholders and category aggregates must not be treated as interchangeable. Do not sum parent categories and named members or infer ultimate beneficial control.
methodology.latest_batch: 35 company-level category disclosures added 1 November 2026; most as at 30 September 2026, Bajaj Auto 30 June and Kotak 31 March
methodology.category_definition: A = promoters, B = public, C2 = employee-trust holdings; sum can be 99.99 or 100.01 from published rounding; absent zero categories are stored as 0 in categoryTotals for newly added records.
